# Hypertext Studio

> A small design lab building sustainable, human-centered software.

The studio works on three products and publishes design studies alongside each major release.

## Products

- [LogDate](https://logdate.app): A more careful home for personal memory.
- Curfew (in design): Software for the version of us that planned ahead.
- Termsly (in design): Know what's actually being agreed to.

- (none yet — the first study will publish alongside the next release)
